bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26220.6780 Released - New features enhance settings management and multi-file sharing for users.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26120.6780 Unveiled - Beta Channel users gain improved settings and multi-file sharing capabilities.
Copilot on Windows Enhancements - New connectors simplify access to personal services like **OneDrive** and **Google Drive**.
Microsoft Azure Launches NVIDIA Cluster - First large-scale cluster for **OpenAI** workloads promises faster model training.
Microsoft Expands Cloud Infrastructure in Asia - New datacenter regions to support growing demand for **AI-ready** services.
Microsoft Ignite 2025 Focuses on Security - Key sessions will address AI-driven security solutions and strategies.
Microsoft Teams Security Enhancements - New guidance aims to disrupt threats targeting **Microsoft Teams** collaboration features.
New Microsoft Secure Future Initiative Patterns - Practical guides to strengthen security across various systems.
Windows ML Overview Released - Enables developers to run ONNX AI models locally on **Windows 11** PCs.
AI Toolkit for Visual Studio Code Launched - Simplifies generative AI app development with integrated tools and models.
